az.step1Desc: The system draws a random footballer from the Serie A 2000-2025 database. Their surname is hidden and must be guessed.
az.step2Desc: The surname lies between "Aarons" and "Żurkowski". Enter a surname from the database: if it comes before the mystery player it becomes the new lower bound, if after it becomes the new upper bound.
az.step3Desc: Each attempt narrows the range. Surnames outside the current range are not accepted. Only surnames present in the database are valid.
az.step4Desc: Guess the exact surname to win! You can also surrender and reveal the mystery footballer.
az.cognomeNonTrovato: Surname not found in the database!
